concept.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
concept.shortdesc: Common questions and answers about the Automated Data Ingestion Pipeline.

section.title: What is the Automated Data Ingestion Pipeline?
section.p: It is a system for collecting, processing, and storing data from multiple sources, designed for scalability and reliability.

section.title: How does it handle errors?
section.p: The pipeline uses robust error handling and real-time monitoring to ensure data integrity and minimize disruptions.

section.title: Can it process both structured and unstructured data?
section.p: Yes, the pipeline is designed to handle a wide variety of data formats.

section.title: Is it suitable for cloud deployment?
section.p: Absolutely. The pipeline leverages scalable cloud infrastructure for performance and flexibility.
